summary: Scoped POS reads; client writes to receipts, register ledgers and POS settings denied on both create and update. The callable validates authenticated saved business access and POS permission; settings require the fixed owner UID. Receipt, ledger and inventory mutations share one transaction, including register-open and version reads. UUID/fingerprint checks prevent duplicate retry accounting. Permission maps retain legacy fields and allow only an optional boolean processSales. Legacy database, Auth logins and Storage are not changed.
limitations: Admin SDK bypasses Firestore rules, so callable validation and fixed named-database selection are required.
Payments are staff-recorded external transactions, not verified processor settlements.
Physical receipt-printer output requires device/driver verification.
